item_code.description: The product this comparison is for, exactly as get_product returned it.

competitor_prices.description: Every distinct price search_competitor_listings' answer clearly states for this product, each matched to the citation it credits that price to. Never include a price the answer did not actually state.

source_name.description: The retailer's name, e.g. 'Amazon' or 'Walmart' — not the raw domain.

url.description: The citation URL search_competitor_listings credited this price to.

price.description: The price as shown on that page.

currency.description: The currency that price is in, e.g. 'USD'.

needs_review.description: Anything an admin should double check — e.g. a competitor listing that may be a different variant or bundle.

notes.description: Anything the admin should know: why few or no competitor prices were found, ambiguities about whether a listing is really the same product, or that web search was unavailable.
